blockers.statement: No final repository-local Triton prefix is accepted. The schema-6 and schema-7 partial prefixes are permanently NON-PASSING and must not be reused; CP29 must prove a fresh schema-8 install.

CP28 accepts only the exact contiguous float32 vecadd profile. Broadcast, cast, reduction, softmax, norm, GEMM, RoPE, cache, GDN, attention, full-model execution, stable multi-token inference, TP, and CCL remain unproven.

changes: Added a normal Python Triton backend/driver that compiles and launches the tutorial-equivalent add_kernel through the self runtime and implicitly managed gem5, then validates application-visible tensors with zero fallback.
Added preload-aware generic kernel mapping and launch support, reusable managed sessions, buffers, queue, signal, packet resources, and exact canonical pure-b010 Triton artifact admission.

Executed two 98432-element contiguous float32 vector-add launches in one Python process and session with bit-exact returned tensors, stable observed resource identities, advancing generations, complete cleanup, and strict simulator trace validation.
Recorded the schema-6 and schema-7 repository-local install attempts as permanently NON-PASSING and deferred a fresh schema-8 install plus broader operator coverage to CP29.
limitations: The accepted Triton image is exactly 5384 bytes with SHA-256 7308427e69dea6f320178c55863291d4d615338eb295a422a5ff7a2c2b8afa95, kernel add_kernel, 12-DWORD preload, 48-byte kernarg, 98432 float32 elements, BLOCK_SIZE 1024, and 97 programs/workgroups per launch.

The two-launch result uses an external isolated precommit package and runtime, not an accepted repository-local prefix. EV-0064's reserved final-v6 requirement is explicitly unsatisfied and EV-0065 does not convert it into a passing install.

The schema-6 install was interrupted after a baked DEFAULT_ROCM_PATH=/opt/rocm was detected; the schema-7 install exited 8 on one queue CTest. Neither partial prefix has a manifest or activation script, and neither may be resumed or promoted.

Kernel source-packet reuse is inferred from the stable image hash, packet VA/CRC, trace, ticket, and dispatch identifiers because the trace has no kernel mapping ID; no same-kernel-mapping-handle claim is made.

The trace emits D2H durability only on the final session-complete event. First-launch correctness is supported by its retired output CRC and exact ordinary-Python returned-tensor oracle, not an independent first-launch D2H durability event.

Only base-pointer contiguous tensors are accepted. Nonzero storage-offset views, a second operator family, persistent model allocations, PyTorch/vLLM execution, multi-token inference, TP, and CCL remain false.
Profiling and performance optimization remain deferred until a retained operator, layer, or model run demonstrates a material bottleneck.

argv: Stabilize the queue mock ordering with a test-only runtime change, prove serial and concurrent queue behavior, and build a fresh schema-8 repository-local prefix with complete OpenCL, Triton, and isolation evidence
next_action.expected: CP-0029 will apply only the queue mock test fix, prove serial and concurrent queue stability plus full GCC/Clang runtime coverage, commit the runtime child, update repository locks, and build a fresh schema-8 prefix whose verify-only, OpenCL, Triton dual-launch, provenance, pollution, and active-isolation gates all pass.
prerequisites: CP-0028 root checkpoint, EV-0064, and EV-0065 are accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.

The runtime child is clean at 7c91133410ce42e4a0a14928fea64c2a89a549e0 / fbc873266dee2d2b1be8682860ed28a9503eefe5, and gem5 remains a clean fixed input at 82eab7b4888c2b414031ceaaa5fe142263cd3d90 / 27b224d5a4dcee75366b013785723f395a937855.
The schema-6 and schema-7 partial prefixes and their failure evidence remain preserved as NON-PASSING and are not reused.
Production queue transport poison and connection-loss behavior remains unchanged; only the mock ordering test may change.
next_action.rollback_boundary: Keep the CP28 isolated normal-Python dual-launch vecadd result accepted but repository_local_install_accepted=false. Do not weaken queue protocol semantics, reuse either partial prefix, or claim broader operators, models, multi-token inference, TP, or CCL if the test-only stabilization or fresh schema-8 installation cannot be completed.
